It reads the model's next-word state, not the token in front of it: replacing the token being read changes nothing (' audio'->' video', 5.17->5.16; ' audio'->' soil', 5.17->4.35) while replacing the word that is about to come collapses it ('buffer'->'sample' 5.17->1.37), and it is near silent on a word's first mention while rising over the next few mentions (first ' audio' 0.5, later ones 4.0-5.2; seven-line list commas 0.0, 1.6, 1.4, 2.3, 2.4, 2.3, 2.5).
